# Hempston Home

> Hempston Home designs and handcrafts custom cabinetry, bespoke kitchens, vanities and built-in millwork. Studios in Halifax (Nova Scotia), Toronto and Long Beach, with installation coast to coast across Canada and the United States.

Hempston is a 100% custom cabinetry maker. Every commission is designed, drawn, and built to the room — never flat-packed, never modular. Signature work includes painted Shaker and inset face-frame kitchens, natural white oak and walnut millwork, butler's pantries, wet bars, custom vanities, mudrooms, laundry rooms, and integrated built-ins.

Design collaborators include 31 Westgate Design Studio, David Bourque, Sara McKeenan, and Hen House. Featured cabinetry projects include Glen Haven, Crombie House, Northwest Cove, and Modern Drift.

Materials, finishes, and hardware are specified from vetted suppliers: solid white oak, walnut, maple, cherry, and MDF substrates; Farrow & Ball and Benjamin Moore paint colours; Rubio Monocoat hardwax-oil stains and conversion-varnish topcoats; hardware from Top Knobs, Emtek, Rejuvenation, and Rocky Mountain Hardware; drawer and hinge systems from Blum and Blum Movento; solid-surface countertops from Caesarstone, Cambria, and natural stone yards.

Services delivered on every project: kitchen design, 3D laser site measures, site coordination visits, construction-grade shop drawings, full-size custom samples, and solid-surface (stone) procurement and management.

Contact: info@hempstonhome.com · (902) 719-8497
